SliderRoot.description: Holds the slider's value and shares it with the parts inside it. Renders a `role="group"` element.

props.value: The value: a number for one thumb, an array for a range with a thumb per entry. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the slider. Or pass it with only `onValueCommitted`: the slider then follows the pointer and keys by itself, and shows `value` again as soon as the owner's `onValueCommitted` has run: the owner's guess, or its old value until it writes the new one. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.
props.defaultValue: The value at first, when it isn't controlled: a number, or an array for a range. Defaults to `min`.
props.onValueChange: Called on every change, many times during a drag, with the new value (a number or an array, as `value` is) and details: the `reason` (`track-press`, `drag`, `keyboard` or `input-change`) and the `activeThumbIndex`. It is called in a change of its own, after the one that moved the thumb, so it may write something a loading question reads without holding the slider.
props.onValueCommitted: Called when a change is final: on pointer release and on each key press. Receives the value and the `reason`. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the slider is never held by it, and goes on from what it shows if moved again while the save is out.
props.step: The values are multiples of `step` from `min`.
props.largeStep: How far Page Up, Page Down and Shift with an arrow key move a thumb.
props.minStepsBetweenValues: How many steps apart a range's thumbs must stay.
props.orientation: Whether the slider runs left to right or bottom to top.
props.disabled: Whether the slider ignores the pointer and the keyboard. Its range inputs are disabled too. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot. A slider disabled while a thumb has focus (`disabled={pending? setting}`) gives focus back to that thumb when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.
props.name: The name each thumb's range input submits its value under. Taken from an enclosing FieldRoot when not given.
props.form: The id of a `<form>` the thumbs' inputs belong to, when the slider isn't inside it.
props.format: `Intl.NumberFormat` options for how `SliderValue` shows the values and the thumbs announce them.
props.locale: The locale used with `format`. Defaults to the browser's.

SliderThumb.description: A thumb: a `<div>` centred on its value with inline `position` and `translate`, around a visually hidden `<input type="range">` that takes focus, carries the slider's ARIA and submits the value. ARIA props given to the thumb (`aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-valuetext`) go to that input. Style focus with `:has(:focus-visible)`.

props.index: Which value this thumb shows: its position in the array for a range. Leave it at 0 for a single-value slider.
props.getAriaLabel: Names each thumb of a range from its index. Takes precedence over `aria-label`.
props.getAriaValueText: The text the input announces for its value, from the formatted value, the value and the thumb's index.
